recipe.criteria: Forearm plank with alternating lateral toe taps: each side 1.5 seconds out, 1 second toe contact, 1.5 seconds back. Moving toes briefly clear floor during each step; pelvis and arms remain fixed.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
